covered_instructions: pantheon-adr create makes a record, slug and type from the branch
Frontmatter is the single source of truth; there is no index file
Records are identified by slug, with no NNNN- number prefix
check <slug> requires the slug and gates review at 80 of 100
Status moves through review and update, which append history entries
Superseding is two steps and links both records
Accepted records are immutable except for their status
Directory resolution: --dir, ADR_DIR, then the committed docs/adr default
Branch ADR template headings kept verbatim and in order
Placeholders forfeit points and cap the score
Options Considered must be populated, and boilerplate does not count
Extracted records record provenance in frontmatter `related`
check-undocumented-decisions.sh finds planning documents with no linked record
uncovered_instructions: Valid statuses are proposed, review-requested, accepted, deprecated, superseded, with no rejected status
